build_image_from_prompt: build an image from a text prompt using the configured FAL model with configurable aspect ratio
build_fal_payload: build a FAL request payload from unified inputs translated to model-specific size spec and filtered by supports whitelist
upscale_image: upscale an existing image using FAL.ai's Clarity Upscaler with configurable creativity and resemblance
check_fal_api_key: check whether the FAL.ai API key is available via environment variable or managed gateway
check_image_generation_requirements: check whether FAL credentials and fal_client SDK are both available for image generation
